name: table
useFor: Use for rows of records people scan and act on (mailboxes, agents and lines, webhooks). Put labels in TableHeader, rows in TableBody, totals or Pagination with bar in a TableFooter or under the table, and row actions as ghost icon buttons in the last cell. Keep cells to one line; truncate long values.
constraints: A dark or purple head row
source: Figma 427:2715: Email (Mailboxes table) and iMessage (Agents and lines table)
